item.text: The failures come from the due-range validator’s regex being embedded in a JavaScript template string: its backslashes were consumed before the browser saw the regex. I’ve corrected the escaping and also preserved the applied range and filter controls when renaming a project by updating its heading in place. I’m checking the rendered script and launch contract now.
